Conceptual schematic, not exact manufacturer's engineering layout. Subject: UV–Vis spectrophotometer. Left: compact benchtop rectangular spectrophotometer with sample compartment and small display. Right: straight horizontal optical path, lamp -> wavelength selector -> transparent rectangular cuvette containing a subtle brown nanosheet dispersion -> photodetector. Incident beam enters left face and weaker transmitted beam leaves right face, label these I₀ and I. The light continues through the liquid, not reflected from it. Short labels only: "UV–Vis", "Light source", "Wavelength selector", "Cuvette", "Detector".
